request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:GUARD

layers.text: Recolour only his skin: the yellow skin of his face, ears, chest, belly, arms and hands becomes a mid-tone grey-green, colour #6b7d45, with shadows only a little darker, #46552e: greener and greyer than now, not yellow, not black, and the face stays clearly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the pot helmet, tusks, eyes, the brown leather straps and kilt, the plank shield with its iron rim, the cleaver, boots, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
